claims.evidence: Witness only reports a kids wooden play/toy cabinet with stickers; no clear condition proof (scratches/warping) or wardrobe-specific features shown.
Witness notes two door sections, but does not confirm 'two step' functionality or what that means.
Witness report describes a blue oval window-like panel and stickers; no mirror is mentioned in the observed details.
No wheels/tyres are described in the witness observations.
No brand/model/receipt/label or age markings are reported as readable.
Witness does not report close-up condition checks (stains/tears).
Witness describes a wooden cabinet/toy storage unit; no foam is mentioned in the observed items.
Witness observations cannot confirm smoke exposure.

risks.risk: Item may not be a wardrobe (could be a toy/play cabinet), affecting buyer value and intended use
risks.proof: A clear photo showing the interior layout (hanging rail vs toy storage), plus the full front/back so it’s obvious it’s a wardrobe and not just a play cabinet.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a kids toy/play cabinet (not a wardrobe) with unknown completeness.

risks.risk: Mirror may be missing or not present (seller claim not shown by witness)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the mirror area (reflective surface visible) and a wider shot showing where it’s mounted.

risks.risk: Wheels/tyres may be missing or non-functional (seller claim not shown by witness)
risks.proof: Bottom/side photo showing tyres/wheels and a short clip of the unit being rolled on a flat surface.

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible in the witness report (scratches, cracks, warping, loose hinges/handles)
risks.proof: Multiple close-up photos of corners/edges/hinges/handles and a clip opening/closing both doors smoothly.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case used condition (possible minor damage/loose hardware).

risks.risk: Safety/stability for a child item (anti-tip, stability, sharp edges, paint quality)
risks.proof: Photo of base and any anti-tip features (if any), plus close-ups of edges/paint finish; also a clip showing it standing stable when gently pushed.
risks.if_unproven: Price with safety risk discounted (as-is, no safety verification).

risks.risk: Material quality unknown (solid wood vs MDF/plywood) which changes durability
risks.proof: Photo of a side edge showing thickness and construction, and a close-up of any joinery; if possible, a photo of the back panel.

risks.risk: Dimensions and fit for the buyer’s space unknown
risks.proof: A photo with a measuring tape (height/width/depth) or a clear measurement list.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the smallest/least useful size range for the category.

risks.proof: Photo of everything included (any accessories, hardware, mirror parts) laid out, plus a checklist shot.

proof_requests: Full front, full back, and both sides in one clear set of photos (so we can confirm wardrobe vs toy cabinet).
Close-up photo of the mirror area (if present) and a wider shot showing its exact location.
Short video clip opening and closing both doors to confirm smooth operation and hinge/handle condition.
Close-ups of corners/edges for cracks, chips, and sharp edges; include paint/finish quality.
Photo with measuring tape for height/width/depth.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as a kids wooden toy/play cabinet with two doors and decorative stickers, so it can be priced at its worst-case within that category; several seller-specific features (mirror, tyres, foam) are not confirmed by the witness report.
